passive.name: Granite Shield

spells.name: Thunderclap
spells.description: Passive: Malphite gains % Armor (%i:scaleArmor%). This effect is increased to % (%i:scaleArmor%) while Granite Shield is active. Active: Malphite's next Attack deals an additional physical damage and creates an aftershock which deals physical damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit in their direction. His Attacks continue to create aftershocks %i:OnHit% On-Hit for the next seconds.
spells.coverageNote: Thunderclap's base armor passive, six-second armed attack, first aftershock, and five-second repeated aftershocks are modeled. Granite Shield can triple the passive armor, but live shield loss is not yet linked to this modifier, so that interaction remains visibly incomplete.

effects.label: Thunderclap Armor
effects.description: An invested W rank grants percent armor.

effects.label: Thunderclap First Attack
effects.description: The next successful attack within six seconds adds the initial bonus and an aftershock.

effects.label: Thunderclap Aftershocks
effects.description: Later successful attacks add aftershock damage for five seconds after the first attack.

effects.label: Granite Shield Armor Multiplier
effects.description: Granite Shield triples the passive armor while the shield remains active.

validationNotes: Reviewed against pinned CommunityDragon champion detail and BIN sources for patch 16.16.

components.label: Thunderclap Passive Armor
components.description: An invested W rank grants 10 / 15 / 20 / 25 / 30% armor.
components.reason: Applied at scenario start from rank data.

components.label: Thunderclap Attack Sequence
components.description: Casting W arms the next attack for six seconds. That attack adds the initial damage and an aftershock, then later attacks add aftershocks for five seconds.
components.reason: Compiled as an armed state followed by a timed repeated on-hit state.

components.label: Granite Shield Armor Multiplier
components.description: The passive armor is tripled while Granite Shield remains active.
components.reason: The runtime does not yet link generated shield depletion and recharge to an active stat modifier. The base passive remains modeled.

components.label: Aftershock Cone
components.description: Aftershock also damages enemies in a cone.
components.reason: The supported target is the selected champion hit by the basic attack.

components.label: Aftershock Monster Modifier
components.description: Aftershock has a monster-only damage modifier.
components.reason: The supported target is a champion.
